name: io.github.WYRE-AI/ncentral-mcp
title: N-able N-central
description: MCP server for N-able N-central RMM: org units, devices, monitoring, tasks, maintenance windows.

packageArguments.description: The image defaults to the S2S-gated HTTP entrypoint; run the stdio entrypoint instead.

environmentVariables.name: NCENTRAL_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your N-central server (e.g. https://ncentral.example.com)

environmentVariables.name: NCENTRAL_JWT
environmentVariables.description: N-central User-API Token (JWT) generated on the user's API Access tab

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
